title: Mughal Garden, Kashmir - A Royal Escape into Srinagar’s Timeless Beauty

Mughal Garden Kashmir - A Royal Escape into Srinagar’s Timeless Beauty

Mughal Garden Kashmir is not just a garden, it is a feeling of royalty, romance, and peace. Located in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, these gardens were built by Mughal emperors who fell in love with Kashmir’s natural beauty. Surrounded by the Zabarwan hills and overlooking the Dal Lake, Mughal gardens are a must-visit for nature lovers, photographers, families, and honeymoon couples.

The three famous Mughal Gardens are Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh, and Chashme Shahi - each with its own charm and history.

History of Mughal Garden Kashmir

The Mughal Gardens were built during the Mughal Empire in the 16th and 17th centuries. Emperor Jahangir, inspired by Persian-style gardens, ordered the construction of these gardens to create a paradise on earth.

The gardens follow the Charbagh pattern, divided into terraces with flowing water channels, fountains, and flower beds - symbolizing heaven as described in Persian culture.

Famous Mughal Gardens in Srinagar

Shalimar Bagh - The Garden of Love

Shalimar Bagh was built by Emperor Jahangir for his wife Noor Jahan. It is the largest and most famous Mughal garden in Kashmir.

  • Beautiful fountains and long water channels
  • Perfect sunset views
  • Best for couples and evening walks
  •  Location: Near Dal Lake, Srinagar

Nishat Bagh - The Garden of Joy

Nishat Bagh, built by Asif Khan, offers one of the best panoramic views of Dal Lake. With 12 terraces representing zodiac signs, this garden feels grand and peaceful.

  • Stunning lake-facing terraces
  • Ideal for photography
  • Popular among families
  •  Location: East side of Dal Lake

Chashme Shahi -The Royal Spring Garden

Chashme Shahi is the smallest Mughal garden but very special due to its natural spring water, believed to have medicinal value.

  • Fresh spring water
  • Calm and less crowded
  • Great quick visit spot
  • Location: Near Raj Bhawan, Srinagar

Best Time to Visit Mughal Garden Kashmir

The best time to visit Mughal Gardens in Kashmir is March to October.

  • Spring (March-April): Blooming tulips & flowers 
  • Summer (May-August): Pleasant weather & greenery 
  • Autumn (September-October): Golden leaves & soft sunlight 
  • Winter months are less ideal as gardens may remain partially closed.

Entry Fee & Timings

  • Timings: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (varies seasonally)
  • Entry Fee: Indians: ₹20-₹30 / Foreigners: ₹200-₹300

Why Mughal Garden Kashmir is a Must-Visit

Mughal Garden Kashmir perfectly blends nature, history, and royal architecture. Whether you’re on a family trip, honeymoon, solo journey, or photography tour, these gardens leave a lasting impression of Kashmir’s timeless beauty.
